question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing center midfielder, Bob is playing left midfielder, Claire is playing benchwarmer, Dave is playing striker, and Eve is playing right back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Alice and Eve trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Finally, Bob and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) center midfielder
(B) left midfielder
(C) benchwarmer
(D) striker
(E) right back
solution:
Positions in order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve
Initial: center midfielder | left midfielder | benchwarmer | striker | right back
1. Alice swaps with Bob: left midfielder | center midfielder | benchwarmer | striker | right back
2. Claire swaps with Dave: left midfielder | center midfielder | striker | benchwarmer | right back
3. Alice swaps with Eve: right back | center midfielder | striker | benchwarmer | left midfielder
4. Claire swaps with Alice: striker | center midfielder | right back | benchwarmer | left midfielder
5. Bob swaps with Eve: striker | left midfielder | right back | benchwarmer | center midfielder
Bob plays left midfielder, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
